name: VendingAgent Market Intelligence
description: Confidential pay-per-call market intelligence gateway. Returns attested financial and crypto data computed inside a Chainlink CRE TEE enclave, gated by Hedera x402 HBAR micropayments via Blocky402.
author: VendingAgent Team – ETHOnline 2026

ingredients.name: vending_query
ingredients.description: Query VendingAgent for attested market intelligence. Handles x402 micropayment automatically.

query.description: Natural language question, e.g. 'What is the current price of HBAR?'

symbol.description: Ticker symbol override (HBAR, BTC, ETH, AAPL, etc.)

data.description: Sanitized market data from Chainlink CRE TEE enclave

ingredients.name: get_vending_pricing
ingredients.description: Retrieve pricing, network, and capability information. Call before vending_query to understand cost.

whenToUse: User asks for crypto prices (HBAR, BTC, ETH, LINK, SOL, AVAX)
User asks for stock market quotes (AAPL, TSLA, MSFT, NVDA, IBM)
User needs market data with privacy guarantees or TEE attestation
User wants to pay per-use instead of subscribing to an API
preconditions: Agent wallet must have ≥ 50,000,000 tinybars (0.5 HBAR) on Hedera Testnet
AGENT_HEDERA_ACCOUNT_ID and AGENT_HEDERA_PRIVATE_KEY must be set
VendingAgent server must be running on SERVER_BASE_URL

stepByStepForLLM.action: Call get_vending_pricing to understand current cost
stepByStepForLLM.reason: Confirm the agent has enough HBAR before committing to a query

stepByStepForLLM.action: Call check_agent_wallet to verify HBAR balance
stepByStepForLLM.reason: Prevent failed transactions due to insufficient funds

stepByStepForLLM.action: Call vending_query with the user's question
stepByStepForLLM.reason: This tool auto-handles the x402 payment and returns attested market data
stepByStepForLLM.note: The tool will automatically: (a) probe for 402 challenge, (b) sign Hedera payment, (c) retry with Authorization header

stepByStepForLLM.action: Present the data to the user with the Hedera transaction ID
stepByStepForLLM.reason: The transaction ID proves payment and can be verified on HashScan testnet explorer

llmGuidance.fallbackStrategy: If vending_query returns an error, check wallet balance with check_agent_wallet. If insufficient, inform the user they need testnet HBAR from https://portal.hedera.com/

confidentialCompute.description: All upstream API calls execute inside a hardware TEE. secrets.API_KEY is injected by CRE Secrets Manager and never leaves the enclave.
